source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus path separators and file bytes, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

commands.result: The harness generated deterministic 1k and 10k synthetic Markdown corpora, measured prior-note reads before indexing, indexing, core text insertion for normal and large-file inputs, warm search, fs.watch response, RSS/heap distributions and CPU time, and emitted release_eligible=false.
The focused contract test passed with 12 expectations, including the Linux-only scope, editable-before-indexing flag, resource/model separation and six explicit external dispositions.
First run retained a moderate complexity finding for the monolithic benchmark profile function.
After splitting collection/report helpers and sharing percentile math, strict changed-file Fallow passed with no issues.

implemented: Added a frozen performance-benchmark fixture with local synthetic profiles, budgets and named external dispositions.

Added an executable Bun benchmark that distinguishes prior-note editability from indexing, reports p50/p95/p99 distributions, records watcher observations and separates model memory (zero model loaded) from app RSS/heap overhead.
Added focused coverage, shared percentile metrics, package/script documentation and bounded CLI options without making platform or renderer claims.
limitations: This is Linux x64 core/synthetic evidence only; no Electron input-to-paint, visible startup, screen-reader, cross-platform or pinned hardware result is claimed.

The 10k profile is generated synthetic content, not a reference Obsidian vault; the 100k profile, reference-vault round trip, long-running resource distribution, stock/plugin comparison and human practical-benefit pilot remain external-pending.
The reported budget_passed fields are local harness checks and do not promote Q-005 through Q-008 to passing acceptance status.
